text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide takes the Japanese<n>Derby crown,
but instead of feeling<n>joy, she comes away with a
sense<n>of fear.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Despite her numerous calculations,<n>Winning Ticket
and Narita Taishin both<n>have something that keeps
defying<n>her estimations.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She tries to figure out what that<n>"something" might
be and concludes<n>that she lacks what they
possess—an<n>iron will to succeed.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Upon reaching this conclusion, she<n>asks me to
increase her training<n>intensity so she won't lose at
the<n>Kikuka Sho.
